concepts.label: Advanced Accessor binary-document support
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - genuinely new mechanism: the Advanced Accessor (couchbase.upsert/get) accepts and returns raw binary payloads (e.g. an ArrayBuffer) in addition to JSON, distinguished on read via meta.datatype

relations.subject: eventing:binary-document-accessor
relations.evidence: The return value of couchbase.upsert() on success will indicate either "datatype":"json" or "datatype":"binary"

notable_absence.finding: The usual 'Version 7.1+/7.0+/6.6.2' server-version-string code-comment ladder recurs here - flagged as recurrence of the known anomaly, not treated as new. No Enterprise/Community edition badge appears on this page.
